note_versions: e-print requests for v2..v5 return "No document"; only v1 (2020-07-06) source exists on arXiv
tables: Appendix "Domain generalization accuracies per algorithm, dataset, and domain" (paper.tex lines 935-1381): 7 datasets x 3 selection rules x 9 algorithms; 837 "mean $\pm$ SE" cells, all parsed (837 $\pm$ in the appendix)
n_trials_source: paper.tex lines 522-524: "We therefore repeat our entire study three times making every random choice anew: hyperparameters, weight initializations, and dataset splits. Every number we report is a mean over these repetitions, together with their estimated standard error."
se_convention: DomainBed initial public release (github.com/facebookresearch/DomainBed commit 8ff97a7, 2020-07-20) domainbed/scripts/collect_results.py format_mean: err = 100 * np.std(list(data) / np.sqrt(len(data))) -> SE = SD_ddof0/sqrt(n); hence sample SD (ddof=1) = SE*n/sqrt(n-1) [columns code_*]; spec convention sd = SE*sqrt(n) (= SD_ddof0) in columns alt_*
caveats: values rounded to 0.1 pp in the source; SE reported as 0.0 means SE < 0.05 (n_se_zero column)
Colored MNIST training-domain table names the adversarial algorithms ADA/CondADA, the other two tables DANN/C-DANN (verbatim from source)
run variance includes hyperparameter-search, initialisation and data-split randomness (whole study repeated)
environment = held-out test environment of a leave-one-environment-out fold (as in the v2 histopathology design)
priors_bayes: half-Cauchy(10 pp) and half-normal(25 pp) on both SDs
se_convention_inference: Inferred, not stated in the paper: the arXiv source (v1, submitted 2020-07-02; 'v1 (2020-07-06)' above is the listing date) gives no formula for the reported SE. The formula is taken from the first public code release, DomainBed commit 8ff97a7 dated 2020-07-20T17:38:36Z (GitHub API), 18 days after the arXiv submission; we assume the paper tables were produced with the same collect_results.format_mean. The alt_* columns (sd = SE*sqrt(n)) bracket the alternative.
reading_notes: training-domain selection: 63 groups (7 datasets x 9 algorithms), 54 excluding Colored MNIST; 8 groups have code_icc_lo < 0.5 in both counts (none is Colored MNIST)

leave-one-domain-out selection, Rotated MNIST: only DANN is unstable across trials (code_icc 0.000, code_sigma_run 14.96); C-DANN has code_icc 0.988 [0.953, 0.998] - one environment scores 73.7 +- 0.0, which inflates sigma_env (9.8), but its trials agree
